/api/fees/bank-import: Not a data change: the legacy direct-write endpoint is closed and always returns 410 after authentication. Bank statements go through /api/import-batches staging, and their commit through /api/import-batches/[batchId], which writes AuditLog.
/api/fees/remind: Sends a guardian message only; no fee, invoice or ledger data changes. Every send attempt is persisted by sendTemplatedCommunication (src/lib/notifications/service.ts) as a parent_communications row with createdById, templateKey, channel, relatedType=INVOICE/relatedId, status and a per-invoice-per-day idempotency key.
/api/import-batches: Stages a preview only: writes an import_batches row in state STAGED (createdById, fingerprint, targetScope, expiresAt) and changes no student or fee data. Rows are applied only by the commit in /api/import-batches/[batchId], which writes AuditLog and the batch receipt atomically.
/api/owner/support/actions/[id]/execute: Platform-owner support access (SKO-390), audited in SuperAdminAuditLog: the school-profile write and the export each create a super_admin_audit_logs row (support_write_completed with old/new field values, support_export_completed) in the same prisma.$transaction as the change and the support_actions status update.
/api/owner/support/actions: Platform-owner support access (SKO-390): queues a support_actions row and writes a super_admin_audit_logs row (support_<action>_queued) in the same prisma.$transaction; no school data changes until execute.
/api/owner/support/grants/[id]: Platform-owner support access (SKO-390): DELETE calls stopSupportGrant (src/lib/owner/support-access.ts), which revokes the grant, cancels queued actions/jobs and writes super_admin_audit_logs (support_access_revoked) in one transaction; PATCH closes the incident and writes super_admin_audit_logs (support_access_<status>, support_incident_closed) in the same prisma.$transaction.
/api/owner/support/grants/[id]/start: Platform-owner support access (SKO-390): the conditional grant activation and the super_admin_audit_logs row (support_access_started) are written in the same prisma.$transaction.
/api/owner/support/grants: Platform-owner support access (SKO-390): the support_incidents row, support_grants row and super_admin_audit_logs row (support_access_requested / support_emergency_access_started) are created in one prisma.$transaction.
/api/school-ai/exams/[id]/marking-propos: Produces a reviewable AI marking proposal only; no attempt, result or gradebook data changes (marks change only through the audited review/revise paths). The single write is the AI credit/usage row (ai_usage_logs via consumeAICreditAndLog) recording userId, assignmentId, attemptId, questionId, idempotencyKey and evidenceHash.
